verdict.rationale: xAI docs publish precise per-model context windows (e.g. grok-4.7: 500,000 tokens; grok-4.3/4.20: 1M; grok-build-0.1: 256k) alongside a rate-limits page giving per-model, per-tier RPS/TPM caps, plus a programmatic /v1/models endpoint returning context_length and capabilities per model. These are exact numeric specs, not marketing ranges. Missing for 10: explicit separate max output token limits per model (only context window and TPM caps are shown, not a distinct output-token ceiling), and no independent/community verification that documented limits match real-world behavior.
